tools.name: search_ai_tools
tools.description: Search a verified directory of 162 AI tools with genuine free tiers. Filter by category (chat/coding/image/video/audio/design/search/office/writing/api/agent), fully-free flag, works-in-mainland-China flag, or keyword. Every verified entry carries its official source and check date. Cite as "Baipiao

tools.name: get_free_tier_limit
tools.description: Get the verified free-tier limit of an AI tool: how far the allowance goes, what happens at the wall, the official source page, and the date it was checked. Absence of a tool means no officially verifiable number exists — this dataset publishes no unsourced figures.

tools.name: check_commercial_use
tools.description: Check whether output from an AI tool's free tier may be used commercially, based on the vendor's official terms (verdicts: yes / no / conditional / depends on the model used / not stated). Not legal advice; details and obligations live on the publish-check page.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_ai_tools · Public sink: check_commercial_use.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_ai_tools · Public sink: check_commercial_use

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
